review_candidates.title: Global Programmes Lead
review_candidates.description: Job Description Who we are: Muslim Aid is a UK faith-based international development organisation that provides support to communities around the world affected by disasters, conflict, or endemic poverty without regard to their social, religious, or ethnic background. Established in 1985, Muslim Aid has facilitated the engagement of the British Muslim and non-Muslim community in support of its work in a variety of ways. Over the years, its humanitarian work has included responses to major crises around the world including, famine in East Africa, earthquakes and flooding in Pakistan and Bangladesh as well as conflicts in Syria and Yemen. We place strong emphasis on long-term development projects that build the capacity of local people to help themselves. In addition to the 5 country offices worldwide we also work with multiple partner offices focusing on sustainable Development Programmes and providing humanitarian relief during times of crisis. Summary Of The Role The Global Programmes Lead is a senior management role within the Impact department, providing leadership and oversight across Muslim Aid's international and UK programme delivery, partnerships, humanitarian response, and safety and security. Reporting to the Head of Impact, the Lead is accountable for the efficient, high-quality and compliant delivery of programmes through the Country Programmes Unit, the Programmes Partnership Unit (including UK programmes), the Humanitarian Programmes function and programme administration, while ensuring robust duty of care through oversight of the safety and security function. The role is responsible for technical and management advice and support to ensure Muslim Aid Country Offices and partners are implementing, monitoring and evaluating programme activities in compliance with Muslim Aid's strategy and budget as well as recognised international standards. The role drives programme quality, value for money and risk management across the portfolio; strengthens the capacity of country offices and partners; and supports institutional funding and strategic partnerships to grow the scope, scale and quality of Muslim Aid's programmes in line with organisational strategy and recognised international standards. Regular international travel will be required. About The Role Provide senior leadership across the Country Programmes Unit, the Programmes Partnership Unit (including UK programmes), the Humanitarian Programmes function and the safety and security function, ensuring they operate as a coherent, high-performing whole. Lead development of departmental strategies and operational plans within the roles remit to ensure they are aligned. Oversee programmes to ensure they are designed, implemented, monitored and evaluated to a high standard and in compliance with donor, governmental and international requirements. Strengthen due diligence and compliance procedures with country offices and partners, and ensure quality standards such as the Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) and Sphere are met. Oversee Capacity Assessments of Country Offices/Affiliate Offices and Implementing Partners, and the implementation of associated improvement plans. Oversee management of the Humanitarian Programmes function and Muslim Aid's emergency response capability, ensuring timely, high-quality and standards-compliant responses to slow- and rapid-onset emergencies. About You You must currently hold the right to work in the UK. Muslim Aid is not offering sponsorship for this role. This role operates on a hybrid working basis, with a requirement to work from the office for a minimum of three days per week, and additional days where required to meet organisational needs. To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need Educated to degree level in international development or a related field. Substantial senior management experience in international development and/or humanitarian programmes, including remote / distance management of country offices and partners. Proven experience leading programme quality, design, MEAL and compliance across a multi-country portfolio. Excellent leadership, project management and facilitation skills. Strong financial management and value-for-money skills, with budget oversight across multiple programmes. Good interpersonal skills, able to work effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels. Why You Should Apply Join Muslim Aid as our Global Programmes Lead and play a key role in leading and strengthening our international and UK programmes, partnerships and humanitarian response. You will oversee programme delivery, quality, compliance and risk management, while supporting country offices and partners to achieve meaningful and sustainable impact. If you are an experienced leader with strong programme management, strategic partnership and humanitarian experience, and a passion for delivering high-quality programmes that transform lives, we would love to hear from you. Benefits You Will Enjoy Working For Us 25 days annual leave + 4 Privilege days Hybrid working – minimum of 2 days per week in the office Paid time off for medical appointments 2 hours lunch break on Fridays Time off in Lieu (TOIL) Pension Scheme How To Apply To apply please submit your cover letter (no more than 1 page) and CV. Pre-employment Checks Due To The Nature Of Our Work With Children And Vulnerable Communities, Muslim Aid Operates Rigorous Safeguarding And Protection From Sexual Exploitation And Abuse (SEA) Procedures In Our Recruitment Process. We Are Committed To The Prevention Of Sexual Abuse And Exploitation And Adopts a Zero-tolerance Approach To SEA, As a Result, Any Employment With Muslim Aid Is Subject To The Following Checks Prior To Your Start Date Satisfactory professional references, including safeguarding-specific enquiries. A Basic Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check and/or an International Criminal Record Check where applicable. A review of right-to-work documentation for the country in which the role is based. We will do everything possible to ensure that only those who are suitable to work with children and vulnerable people are recruited to work for us. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, or age. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Applications will be accepted until the closing date, however, Muslim Aid reserves the right to initiate interviews and the selection process on a rolling basis with the aim of identifying an appropriate candidate as quickly as possible. review_candidates.title: Financial Planning Manager
review_candidates.location: WP. Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
review_candidates.description: About The Role The Financial Planning Manager is responsible for leading the Company's corporate financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management functions. The role focuses on developing and monitoring annual budgets, forecasting company revenue and expenditure, managing working capital requirements, and ensuring effective cash flow planning to support business operations and sustainable growth. Working closely with Management, Finance, Project and Operations teams, the role will provide financial insights and strategic recommendations to support business decisions, improve financial performance, optimise resource allocation and strengthen the Company's financial position. What You Will Do 1. Corporate Financial Planning & Strategy Develop and implement the Company's corporate financial planning strategies in alignment with business objectives and growth plans. Translate business strategies into financial plans, budgets and measurable financial targets. Analyse the Company's financial performance and identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability and operational efficiency. Evaluate business expansion opportunities, new projects and investments from a financial perspective. Provide financial analysis, insights and recommendations to Management to support strategic decision-making. Monitor overall financial performance and identify potential financial risks and improvement areas. 2. Budgeting & Financial Forecasting Lead the annual budgeting process, including revenue, operating expenditure (OPEX), capital expenditure (CAPEX) and project budgets. Develop and maintain financial forecasts covering company revenue, expenses, profitability and funding requirements. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial projections based on business performance and operational requirements. Work closely with department heads and project teams to establish realistic budgets and financial targets. Monitor actual financial performance against approved budgets and forecasts. Conduct variance analysis and identify reasons for budget deviations, recommending corrective actions where necessary. Review and update financial forecasts based on project progress, new business opportunities and changing market conditions. 3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Oversee the Company's cash flow planning and forecasting to ensure sufficient liquidity to support daily operations and business commitments. Develop short-term and long-term cash flow projections, including weekly, monthly and annual cash flow forecasts. Forecast cash inflows from project billings, customer collections, contract payments and other revenue streams. Forecast cash outflows covering project costs, payroll, suppliers, subcontractors, operational expenses, financing commitments and other business obligations. Monitor working capital requirements and ensure sufficient funds are available for ongoing and upcoming projects. Analyse cash flow gaps and identify potential funding requirements to support business operations. Work closely with Finance and relevant departments to improve accounts receivable collection, accounts payable management and payment scheduling. Identify opportunities to optimise working capital, minimise cash tied up in projects and improve cash conversion cycles. Monitor outstanding customer payments, overdue receivables, retention sums and project-related collections. 4. Project Financial Planning & Cost Control Oversee financial planning and budgeting for ongoing and upcoming engineering, construction and industrial service projects. Review project cost estimates, budgets, expected revenue, margins and financial viability before project commencement. Monitor project financial performance against approved budgets and contractual values. Work closely with Project Managers and Operations teams to track project expenditure, committed costs and projected final costs. Review project cash flow requirements, including mobilisation costs, material procurement, subcontractor payments and progress claims. Monitor project billing milestones, work-in-progress (WIP), progress claims and outstanding payments. Identify potential cost overruns, margin erosion and project financial risks, recommending appropriate corrective measures. Conduct project profitability analysis to evaluate actual performance and expected returns. 5. Financial Performance Monitoring & Management Reporting Prepare and present monthly, quarterly and annual financial performance reports to Management. Monitor key financial indicators, including revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash flow and working capital. Analyse financial trends, budget variances and business performance across different projects and business segments. Develop financial dashboards and management reports to provide visibility on the Company's financial position. Highlight financial risks, cash flow constraints and areas requiring Management's attention. Provide financial insights and recommendations to improve business performance and profitability. 6. Financial Risk Management & Business Planning Identify and assess financial risks relating to business operations, project execution, cash flow and working capital. Evaluate the financial impact of new projects, contracts and business commitments. Assess project funding requirements and recommend appropriate financial arrangements. Monitor market conditions, industry developments and cost trends that may impact the Company's financial performance. What You Should Have Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related discipline. Professional qualifications such as ACCA, CIMA, CPA, ICAEW or equivalent will be an added advantage. Minimum 10 years of relevant working experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, corporate planning or financial analysis. At least 3–5 years of managerial or leadership experience. Strong experience in cash flow forecasting, working capital management, financial modelling and budgetary control. Experience in the engineering, construction, Oil & Gas, petrochemical, industrial services or project-based industries is highly preferred. Exposure to project costing, project budgeting, contract revenue and project profitability management is an advantage. Strong understanding of financial statements, management accounts and financial performance analysis.

review_candidates.description: GRS Recruitment is working on behalf of a prestigious multinational organisation to recruit an experienced and highly professional Executive Office Manager for its impressive three-floor offices in Nicosia. This is a senior and highly trusted position within a lean team, offering significant responsibility and variety. The successful candidate will take ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Nicosia office while providing high-level administrative and operational support to the senior leadership team. Working closely with the CEO, CFO and wider office team, the Executive Office Manager will take ownership of a broad range of operational, administrative and office management responsibilities, ensuring the smooth running of the Nicosia office while enabling senior leadership to focus on strategic business priorities. We are looking for an exceptionally organised, proactive and hands-on professional who is equally comfortable managing a prestigious corporate office, supporting senior executives, coordinating international travel, liaising with suppliers and landlords, and assisting with basic bookkeeping and financial administration. Key Responsibilities Office & Facilities Management Take full ownership of the smooth and professional day-to-day operation of the Nicosia office. Oversee the facilities and general management of the company's three-floor office premises. Act as the primary point of contact for the landlord, building management, suppliers, contractors and service providers. Ensure office equipment, facilities and services are fully operational and maintained to an excellent standard. Coordinate repairs, maintenance, office supplies and other facilities-related requirements. Manage relationships with external vendors and service providers, ensuring consistently high standards. Support the day-to-day needs of employees based within the Nicosia office. Ensure the office provides a professional and welcoming environment for employees, executives, clients and international visitors. Executive & Administrative Support Provide high-level administrative and coordination support to the CFO, Director and wider senior team. Assist with meetings, appointments, schedules and general business administration as required. Coordinate arrangements for international employees, executives and other visitors travelling to Cyprus. Take ownership of routine administrative and operational matters to reduce the day-to-day workload of senior management. Prepare and maintain documentation, records and other administrative information as required. Handle confidential, sensitive and commercially important information with complete discretion. Anticipate requirements and resolve operational issues proactively, without the need for constant direction. Travel Management Take ownership of corporate travel coordination, working closely with the company's appointed travel agency. Arrange flights, hotels, transfers and other travel requirements for executives and employees. Prepare and coordinate complete travel itineraries, ensuring all arrangements are communicated clearly. Manage changes, cancellations and last-minute travel requirements efficiently. Assist with visa arrangements and supporting travel documentation when required, liaising with travel agencies, employees and other relevant parties. Maintain accurate records relating to corporate travel and assist with associated travel administration and expenses. Basic Bookkeeping & Financial Administration Provide support with basic bookkeeping and day-to-day financial administration. Assist with invoices, receipts, expense records and general financial documentation. Maintain accurate records and ensure relevant paperwork is appropriately organised and filed. Liaise with the CFO and other relevant stakeholders regarding financial administration when required. Support other straightforward accounting-related administrative tasks within the scope of the position. Candidate Profile We are looking for a high-calibre, experienced and exceptionally capable professional who is accustomed to working within a demanding corporate environment and is comfortable taking genuine ownership of their responsibilities. The successful candidate will ideally have: Significant previous experience as an Executive Office Manager, Senior Office Manager, Administration Manager, Executive Assistant, or in a similarly senior operational support position. Proven experience managing a busy professional or corporate office environment. Previous experience supporting Directors, C-suite executives or other senior stakeholders. Strong facilities management and supplier/vendor coordination experience. Experience coordinating international business travel, including flights, accommodation, itineraries and associated arrangements. Previous exposure to visa coordination and international travel documentation would be advantageous. Experience or knowledge of basic bookkeeping and financial administration. An LCCI qualification or higher in Bookkeeping or Accounting would be highly advantageous. Strong numerical skills and confidence working with invoices, expenses, records and routine financial documentation. Excellent organisational, administrative and problem-solving skills. The ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously. A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to identify what needs to be done and take ownership. Exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with employees, senior executives and external stakeholders. A polished, professional and service-oriented approach. A high degree of discretion, integrity and confidentiality. Fluency in both Greek and English, written and spoken. Strong Microsoft Office and general computer skills. The Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished Executive Office Manager to become a central and highly trusted member of a successful multinational organisation in Nicosia. This is not a traditional office administration position. The successful candidate will act as an important operational right hand to the senior leadership team, taking responsibility for a wide range of matters and ensuring that the office and its day-to-day operations run seamlessly. The position offers considerable variety, autonomy and responsibility, covering everything from facilities and office management through to executive support, international travel coordination, visa administration and basic bookkeeping. It would particularly suit someone who takes genuine pride in being the person who makes things happen, enjoys being relied upon and has the confidence and experience to take ownership without needing constant direction.

review_candidates.title: CFO - Real Estate / Construction Industry Only
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Location: Hyderabad, Telangana Industry: Real Estate & Property Development Department: Finance & Accounts Reporting To: Managing Director / CEO Role Overview We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the Finance & Accounts function of a growing real estate organization. The CFO will be responsible for financial strategy, project finance, cash-flow management, financial planning, MIS, taxation, compliance, banking relationships, fundraising, and risk management. The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to the real estate / construction / infrastructure sector, with a proven ability to manage project-level finances and support senior management in strategic business decisions. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Strategy & Leadership Develop and execute the company's overall financial strategy aligned with business and growth objectives. Provide strategic financial insights to the CEO/MD and management team. Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and long-term financial modelling. Evaluate new projects, investments, acquisitions, and business opportunities from a financial perspective. Establish strong financial controls, governance, and risk-management processes. 2. Real Estate Project Finance Manage financial planning and monitoring for ongoing and upcoming real estate projects. Prepare project-wise budgets, cost estimates, profitability analysis, and financial projections. Monitor project cash flows, construction costs, receivables, payables, and project profitability. Evaluate project feasibility, IRR, ROI, margins, break-even, and funding requirements. Work closely with Projects, Sales, Procurement, and Business teams to control project costs. 3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Ensure effective management of company and project-level cash flows. Prepare rolling cash-flow forecasts and identify funding gaps proactively. Optimize working capital and ensure timely collections and payments. Monitor customer receivables, vendor liabilities, and project commitments. Ensure adequate liquidity for ongoing project execution. 4. Fundraising & Banking Manage relationships with banks, NBFCs, financial institutions, investors, and other funding partners. Lead project financing, construction finance, working-capital facilities, and structured funding. Negotiate financing terms, interest rates, security structures, and credit facilities. Support equity/debt fundraising and investor discussions. Manage banking documentation, covenants, and compliance requirements. 5. Accounting, Taxation & Compliance Oversee accounting, financial reporting, statutory audits, internal audits, and taxation. Ensure compliance with applicable GST, Income Tax, Companies Act, RERA, and other regulatory requirements. Ensure timely closure of books and preparation of accurate financial statements. Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, legal advisors, and other external stakeholders. Strengthen internal controls and financial governance across the organization. 6. MIS & Management Reporting Develop and implement robust financial MIS and reporting systems. Provide monthly and quarterly management reports covering revenue, costs, cash flow, profitability, receivables, payables, and project performance. Establish project-wise financial dashboards and KPIs. Highlight financial risks, deviations, and corrective actions to the management. 7. Commercial & Business Support Partner with the CEO/MD on strategic and commercial decisions. Review contracts, commercial agreements, JV arrangements, and major vendor/customer commitments. Support pricing, sales strategy, payment structures, and commercial negotiations. Evaluate joint ventures, land acquisitions, redevelopment opportunities, and other strategic investments. 8. Team & Process Leadership Lead and mentor the Finance & Accounts team. Build a high-performance finance function with clear processes and accountability. Drive automation and improvement of finance processes and reporting systems. Ensure strong coordination between Finance, Projects, Sales, Procurement, Legal, and Operations. Desired Candidate Profile Qualification: CA / CMA / MBA Finance preferred. Experience: Typically 15+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with significant experience in a senior finance leadership role. Strong preference for candidates with experience in Real Estate / Construction / Infrastructure / Property Development. Strong understanding of project finance, cash-flow management, financial modelling, taxation, banking, fundraising, and commercial finance. Experience managing finance for multiple real estate projects will be highly preferred. Strong leadership, negotiation, analytical, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management capabilities. Strong understanding of statutory and regulatory compliance applicable to the real estate sector. Key Competencies Strategic Financial Planning Project Finance Financial Modelling Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Fundraising & Debt Management Banking & Investor Relations Real Estate Finance Budgeting & Forecasting MIS & Business Analytics Taxation & Compliance Risk Management Commercial Acumen Leadership & Team Management Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Project and company profitability Cash-flow efficiency Working-capital optimization Cost control and budget adherence Timely financial reporting Successful fundraising and financing Receivables and collection efficiency Compliance and audit performance Financial risk management
